preregistration.fixed_on: 2026-10-22, before the first full run (plan row R9)
preregistration.question: Does a short leg through USDT-margined perpetual swaps at no leverage (collateral >= position) improve the Sprint 2c trend rules out of sample on BTC-USDT and ETH-USDT, after fees, slippage and funding?
preregistration.entry_rules_and_grids: exactly Sprint 2c's (research/strategies), brackets none/tp2/trail1/time30 (none only for S1+S5)
preregistration.short_rules: mirror images with the same parameters: S1 >= vote lookbacks negative; S2 close below the prior entry_days low with the same volume/ATR filters, cover above the prior exit_days high; S4 close below the lower band after a squeeze, cover above the mid band; S5 mirror: no new short while the funding z-score < -funding_z_max or open interest surges; ATR stop above the entry; a short needs a finite stop
preregistration.priority: the long side is the long-only rule unchanged; a short may only start while it is flat and the S0 filter (and the S5 mirror) allow a new entry; one position at a time; the long side wins a tie

designs.hybrid: long on spot (fee 0.10 %, no funding), short on the perpetual swap (fee 0.05 % + funding)
designs.perp: long and short on the perpetual swap (fee 0.05 % + funding)

preregistration.funding: Binance BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT public funding history as the proxy for OKX's swaps (OKX keeps months); each settlement charged on the position open at the close of the bar it settles in, on |quantity| x that close; longs pay positive rates, shorts receive them; OKX's own funding compared with the proxy where both exist
preregistration.sizing: Sprint 2c's fixed policy vt10/30 crash15/90dh ladder (rebalance threshold 0.25, ladder re-arm 30 days), the same fraction for both sides, fraction <= 1 so a short's notional at entry never exceeds the equity behind it
preregistration.walk_forward: train 540 d -> purge 7 d -> test 180 d; Sharpe with >= 20 train trades; entries first, then the bracket
phase9_evidence_rule: (1) passes the v1c gates on the walk-forward
(2) the short leg alone has a walk-forward profit factor > 1 after costs and funding
(3) walk-forward Calmar above Sprint 2c's long-only result for the same family and series
(4) the untouched holdout confirms (positive return, profit factor > 1, >= 10 trades)
preregistration.holdout: last 12 months (2025-10-20 -> 2026-10-20), opened once and only for configurations meeting (1)-(3); known in advance: BTC -26 %, ETH -39 % over these months (Sprint 2c, R5b), so a confirmation is weak and a contradiction strong evidence
diagnostics_not_gates: slippage x2/x3 and funding x2 replays
the short leg replayed on OKX perpetual-swap candles
funding by year, spot-perp basis, the largest rises against a short

post_hoc.added: 2026-10-22, after the smoke run of S1 on BTC-USDT 4H and before the full run
post_hoc.what: the shorts of every configuration replayed with the policy sizing minus its crash filter (vol target and ladder only), on the walk-forward's own per-window selections
post_hoc.why: the pre-registered policy applies Sprint 2b's crash filter to both sides; it halves exposure while the price is more than 15 % below its 90-day peak, which is the market state in which a short leg is expected to earn — the Phase 9 design has to know what that rule costs the shorts

review_fixes.what: flips: a short that the long side needs now closes at the open before that bar's stops are checked, so the long enters where the long-only rule enters; before, a short whose stop also fired in the flip bar was booked at its stop and the long entered one bar late, against the pre-registered 'long side unchanged'
review_fixes.effect: changes numbers of configurations with flips (mostly S1 and S1+S5); tested: the long side now trades exactly like the long-only rule

review_fixes.what: the S5 mirror and the S0 filter gate a short's start one after the other, in the long side's order (they were combined on one bar)
review_fixes.effect: S1+S5 only, a fraction of a percent of short bars

review_fixes.what: a leg without a losing trade has profit factor 999 (Sprint 2c's convention) instead of an empty value
the holdout can only be opened by the full pre-registered study (never in quick mode or on a subset), and every opening is appended to a ledger the report shows

holdout_ledger.results_file: not kept (the first full run wrote to a temporary file)
holdout_ledger.note: First full run. The independent code review then found that a flip (short to long or back) was delayed by one bar when the old position's stop fired in the flip bar; the engine was fixed and the study re-run (next entry). Recorded here because these four holdout results were seen before the re-run.
